verdict.rationale: Smithery has no documented natural-language command interface for operating the product itself. The closest evidence is the CLI's `smithery tool find [query]`, which searches tools "by name or intent," and a probe noting an official MCP server at the connect docs. That MCP server could, by implication, let an agent drive Smithery through natural language. Missing for 10: a documented natural-language interface for managing connections, publishing and namespaces; explicit docs showing an agent operating Smithery conversationally via its MCP server; hands-on or independent corroboration.
